executionScenarios.name: posts-to-three
executionScenarios.description: The provided video is published to all three platforms
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The input provides a video URL and caption. The Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok publish calls each return success with a post id.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow executes without errors and posts the video to Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

conversation.text: I want to automatically post a video to my social media — Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
Where does the video come from, and what triggers a post?

[Say you'll provide the video and a caption through a form/manual input, and each run should publish that same video to Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. If asked for accounts or credentials, give placeholders and continue.]

description: Sourced from a real Instance AI conversation (thread 788937d4) that built and executed successfully: publishing one video to three social platforms. Multi-turn so the terse request doesn't stall on a source/trigger question.
outcomeExpectations: The workflow takes a video (and caption) as input via a form/manual trigger.
It publishes the video to all three platforms — Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
